text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-- The South Korean parliament's Administration Committee Chaiman, Kim-In Kon, told Vietnam's National Assembly Chairman Nong Duc Manh that the relationship between both parliaments would hopefully bolster relations betweeen the two countries.
-- An offshore oilfield, which is located in area where the maritime territory of Vietnam and Malaysia overlap, will be exploited from early July, Petrovietnam said.
-- The Vietnamese government held a two-day meeting, focusing on an education, public health and culture report.
-- Burma's Trade Minister, Tun Kyi, agreed with Vietnam's Minister of Trade Le Van Triet to create measures for the promotion of bilateral trade and economic cooperation.
-- Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet urged the press to give full information on the issue of reforestation so that the public will understand government policy.
